config.smartkeyprompts.title: Smart Key Prompts
config.smartkeyprompts.smart_key_prompts: Adjust the scale of the key prompt HUD. Range: 0.0 (invisible) to 10.0 (very large).

Set the position of the key prompt HUD on screen.
1: Top Left
2: Top Center (disabled)
3: Top Right
4: Middle Left
5: Bottom Right
6: Bottom Center (disabled)
7: Bottom Left
8: Center
List of prompt group IDs to hide. Add mod integration IDs (e.g., 'jei_skp', 'emi_skp') to disable their prompts.
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.title: Guide Controls
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.hint: Click a binding to change it. Esc cancels the current edit.
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.capture_hin: Choose a key or mouse button for %s. Esc cancels.
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.clear_hint: Leave this action without a key binding.
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.missing_hin: The action %s is not registered in this client. Its mod may not be installed.
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.conflict_hi: Also used by %s (%s overlapping actions). You may keep it or choose another key.
screen.smartkeyprompts.guide.saved: Changes are saved immediately and apply to all worlds.
command.smartkeyprompts.guide.invalid: Provide 1 to %s key binding IDs, separated by spaces or commas.
command.smartkeyprompts.guide.no_receive: No target player supports key guides. Check that their client has the matching SmartKeyPrompts version installed.
command.smartkeyprompts.guide.sent: Sent a key guide to %s player(s).
command.smartkeyprompts.guide.skipped: Skipped %s player(s) without key guide support.
